answer_1.quote: In this work, we focus on the task of general purpose single document summarization... We conduct a thorough investigation of the broad unfaithfulness problems in extractive summarization.
answer_1.outputs: extractive summaries (sentences or elementary discourse units)

answer_2.quote: We examine whether these problems can be automatically detected by 5 widely-used metrics, including ROUGE and 4 faithfulness evaluation metrics for abstractive summarization (FactCC, DAE, QuestEval, BERTScore).

answer_4.quote: We ask humans to label unfaithfulness problems out of 1600 model extracted summaries... Annotators are asked to judge whether the summary has each of the five types of unfaithfulness via five yes or no questions.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators answer five yes/no questions per summary about incorrect coreference, incomplete coreference, incorrect discourse, incomplete discourse, and misleading information.
